t: You're standing where Kilburn Priory once stood. It was a small community of nuns, founded around 1130 to 1134, about three miles north-west of the City, where Watling Street met the stream now called the Westbourne. The priory gave its name to Kilburn, and echoes of it survive in Priory Road and Abbey Road. Much later, in 1842, Frances Parkes, a schoolmistress from Warwick, died here. The old name of the stream meant either the royal stream or the cow's stream.
